headline: 70,000 lines and 675 tests in, and every critic is still choosing the reference product. Round three is where they stop finding crashes and start finding the things that separate a real billing system from a convincing one: a graduated free tier that restarts on every settlement window, calculated properties evaluated without a dependency graph, an invoice that cannot be credited.

waves.name: Wave 0 · Foundation
waves.note: Kernel, contracts and the demo workspace. Built directly, not delegated.

pieces.title: Data layer & migrations
pieces.note: node:sqlite, namespaced migrations, savepoint transactions

pieces.title: Exact money arithmetic
pieces.note: integer minor units, BigInt rationals, largest-remainder allocation

pieces.title: Billing-grade time
pieces.note: anchor-day period maths, virtual clock, replayable job queue

pieces.title: API kernel
pieces.note: router, validation, idempotency, rate limits, generated OpenAPI

pieces.title: Event log & jobs
pieces.note: one event stream feeding webhooks, automation, timeline and audit

pieces.title: Workspace core
pieces.note: orgs, people, auth, API keys, audit trail, time machine

pieces.title: Design tokens
pieces.note: full light and dark palettes, type scale, elevation, motion

waves.name: Wave 1 · The spine
waves.note: Everything downstream depends on these. The app shell follows immediately after the design system lands.

pieces.title: Design system
pieces.note: The component kit: buttons, fields, tables, menus, overlays, charts — in both themes
pieces.verdict: Both original blockers are dead — verified at four viewports with numbers, not vibes. But the sweep stopped one level shallow: every dropdown menu is unusable by keyboard, because the key handler sits on a descendant of the element that actually receives focus.

pieces.title: Smart CRM data model
pieces.note: Objects, custom properties, associations, records, timeline — the substrate
pieces.verdict: The timeline pager is now excellent — 500+ paged requests across same-millisecond clusters with exact set equality. But calculated properties are evaluated in index order with no dependency graph, so one built on another persists a save stale, and a dependency cycle is accepted and mutates the record on every no-op save.

pieces.title: AI engine & tool runtime
pieces.note: Grounded reasoning over real workspace data, tool calling, cost and trace capture
pieces.verdict: Comparison windows, the tool allowlist and the approval gate were rebuilt; the round-3 critic never got to run before the limit reset.

pieces.title: Product catalog & pricing
pieces.note: Flat, per-seat, tiered, volume, package, usage and hybrid prices in every currency
pieces.verdict: Boolean query params and the misleading tier prose were fixed; the round-3 critic never got to run before the limit reset.

pieces.title: App shell & navigation
pieces.note: Navigation, command palette, global search, the shortcut model, a real sign-in, and the time machine one click from the top bar
pieces.verdict: Shell, command palette, global search and the time-machine control landed; its critic hit the limit before reporting.

waves.name: Wave 2 · Revenue
waves.note: Two dependency chains in parallel: customers/subscriptions to invoicing to payments to revenue, alongside metering/credits to entitlements. Every critic attacks the arithmetic first.

pieces.title: Customers, subscriptions & proration
pieces.note: Anchor-day cycles, trials, schedules with phases, and one proration function shared by preview and charge
pieces.verdict: A proration engine the critic could not make lose a cent in USD, JPY or BHD — 746 invoices, every line summing to its total across 400 days. But the invoice it produces cannot be taxed and cannot be credited, and cancel_at in the past slips through the one entry point the last fix missed.

pieces.title: Usage metering & prepaid credits
pieces.note: Exactly-once ingestion, incremental hourly rollups, an append-only credit ledger and a documented burn-down order
pieces.verdict: 1.5M minor units of metered usage now reaches real invoice lines and 377 settlements reconcile perfectly — but the same engine prices 238,353 metered events at $0.00 through its own remediation route, because the graduated free tier restarts on every settlement window.

pieces.title: Invoicing, credit notes & tax
pieces.note: The tax engine and its migrations exist but are not yet applied at issuance — wiring them together, plus credit notes, is the next task

pieces.title: Payments, retries & dunning
pieces.note: Payment methods, failures, retry strategy, recovery, grace periods

pieces.title: Entitlements & feature gating
pieces.note: Features, limits, real-time checks the product can call

pieces.title: Revenue reporting
pieces.note: MRR movement, churn, cohorts, deferred revenue, collections

waves.note: HubSpot parity for the people who actually work the business every day.

pieces.title: Contact, company & record pages
pieces.note: Timeline, properties, associations, inline editing, activity

pieces.title: Deals & pipelines
pieces.note: Kanban, stages, weighted forecast, deal rooms

pieces.title: Lists & segmentation
pieces.note: A filter builder that handles real conditions, active and static lists

pieces.title: Shared inbox & conversations
pieces.note: Threads, email, chat, assignment, snoozes, SLA timers

pieces.title: Support desk
pieces.note: Tickets, queues, escalation, satisfaction

pieces.title: Campaigns, email & forms
pieces.note: Campaign builder, email composer, forms, landing pages, attribution

pieces.title: Sequences
pieces.note: Multi-step cadences with enrollment rules and reply detection

pieces.title: Reports & dashboards
pieces.note: A real report builder over every object, saved dashboards, charts

waves.name: Wave 4 · Autonomy
waves.note: The part that actually runs the business without a human in the loop.

pieces.title: Workflow automation
pieces.note: Triggers, branches, delays, goals, enrollment, a visual builder that edits real workflows

pieces.title: Autonomous agents
pieces.note: Prospecting, support, success, finance and ops agents with runs, traces and approvals

pieces.title: Copilot

pieces.title: Scoring & insights
pieces.note: Lead score, health score, churn risk, next best action, forecast

waves.note: Where customers and developers meet the platform.

pieces.title: Customer billing portal
pieces.note: Self-serve plan changes, payment methods, invoice history, cancel flow

pieces.title: Pricing, quotes & checkout
pieces.note: Plan picker, quotes, a checkout that actually completes

pieces.title: API, webhooks & SDK
pieces.note: Signed webhook delivery with retries, an API reference, a typed SDK

pieces.title: Settings & administration
pieces.note: Roles, teams, data quality, import/export, audit

pieces.title: Home, search & onboarding
pieces.note: The first screen, global search, notifications, a setup guide that knows what is done
